title: Cozy Lockeland Springs Private Loft
description:
Enjoy Your stay in this rustic yet modern studio garage loft apartment located in historic, Lockeland Springs, one block from Shelby Park, 2 miles from downtown and just a few blocks walk or ride to Nashville's hip and trendy "Five Points" area.

The space
This loft has a rustic feel, wood and metal tin walls, ceiling fans, airtight and well insulated!
Full kitchen & refrigerator, Queen size bed, fold out futon someone can use as an additional bed, cable & wi-fi.

Guest access
Private entrance, no smoking inside, there’s an outside deck for smoker's, courtyard for lounging and grilling.

Other things to note
Located in the Heart of East Nashville! One block from "The Frothy Monkey” (coffee shop) and "The Chocolate Factory"  
We're just a few blocks from all the bars & restaurants in 5 Points. Some of Our favorites are Drifter's BBQ, 5 Points Pizza, Burger Up, Mas Tacos and  The Rosepepper Cantina. Don't hesitate to reach out for more suggestions or recommendations !
